moves.label: Quick Namekian Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a short active window that snaps out a close-range arm check.
moves.reason: Three-frame standing poke with a high arm swipe and quick recovery.

moves.label: Low Namekian Sweep
moves.description: Slow low kick with long active reach that sweeps across the shin line before recovering.
moves.reason: Extended crouched leg path clearly attacks low across several active frames.

moves.label: Stretch Arm Body Blow
moves.description: Fast mid stretch punch with a long active window that keeps pressure in front of Piccolo.
moves.reason: Arm extends forward at torso height and stays active for most of the sequence.

moves.label: Heavy Namekian Kick
moves.description: Slow mid rising kick with a committed arc and weak right tracking on whiff.
moves.reason: Tall kicking sequence rises through the body line and matches existing weak-right tracking.

moves.label: Namekian Twin Assault
moves.description: Quick mid two-hit assault that chains a hand feint into a forward kick with modest recovery.
moves.reason: Two-limb standing attack sequence reads as a compact mid string.

moves.label: Demon Cross Rush
moves.description: Steady mid ki rush with a long active sequence of cross-body strikes and quick finish.
moves.reason: Uses ki and shows a long forward striking chain without a clear pop-up visual.

moves.label: Namekian Tornado Kick
moves.description: Fast jumping mid spin kick that works as a tornado extender with a short recovery.
moves.reason: The airborne twisting kick visually supports both jump and tornado properties.

moves.label: Low Demon Pop-Up
moves.description: Slow low launcher that dips under pressure, kicks upward, and jumps into the lift.
moves.reason: Starts low and transitions into an upward aerial kick, matching low launcher flags.

moves.label: Low Aerial Knockdown
moves.description: Slow low hop kick with a tiny active window that commits into a knockdown ender.
moves.reason: Low start, airborne kick path, and heavy landing frames support low knockdown.

moves.label: Demon Flying Crush
moves.description: Slow mid jumping crush with brief active frames and heavy knockdown recovery.
moves.reason: Shared jump-kick body shape hits mid and ends as a committed knockdown finisher.

moves.label: Crouch Aura Burst
moves.description: Fast mid crouch strike with a long active flare that recovers almost immediately.
moves.reason: Full-crouch command shows a compact burst around Piccolo rather than a high poke.

moves.label: Crouch Demon Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with long active rising pressure that lifts from a low stance.
moves.reason: Crouching startup rises into a lifting arm/body sequence, matching authored launch height.

moves.label: Overdrive Jab Swipe
moves.description: Fast high overdrive jab with balanced timing and a compact arm swipe.
moves.reason: Overdrive variant reuses the short high swipe silhouette.

moves.label: Mystic Arm Drive
moves.description: Instant special knockdown drive with very long active stretch-arm pressure.
moves.reason: Piccolo's elastic arm extends far across the screen and has the existing knockdown role.

moves.label: Overdrive Flying Kick
moves.description: Quick mid overdrive jump kick with long active travel and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Airborne kick sequence travels forward without a clear launcher or knockdown finish.

moves.label: Sidestep Flying Kick
moves.description: Quick mid sidestep jump kick with long active travel and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Same airborne kick family as the overdrive version, entered from sidestep.

moves.label: Rising Flying Kick
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising jump kick with a brief active hit and high recovery.
moves.reason: While-standing command leaves the ground into the same flying kick posture.

moves.label: Ducking Namekian Jab
moves.description: Fast high ducking jab with even timing and a short forward swipe.
moves.reason: The move uses the high jab swipe frames from a crouch/down input.

moves.label: Demon Rising Launcher
moves.description: Instant mid launcher with long active rising pressure that pops foes high.
moves.reason: Rising strike and follow-through clearly support the existing launcher height.

moves.label: Forward Stretch Rush
moves.description: Fast mid forward rush with long active stretch-arm reach for sustained pressure.
moves.reason: Forward-input sequence extends Piccolo's arm through several body-height frames.

moves.label: Demon Jab Swipe
moves.description: Fast high quarter-circle jab with steady timing and a compact arm swipe.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle version visually matches the high jab swipe frames.

moves.label: Demon Aerial Knockdown
moves.description: Slow mid jump kick with brief active impact and heavy knockdown recovery.
moves.reason: Aerial kick sequence ends in a committed finisher and retains authored knockdown.
